name: Eos AI
brief:
Product: Eos AI
One-liner: Autonomous OS for healthcare
Description: Eos helps clinics turn their data into actionable insights to identify more eligible patients and early care interventions. We harmonize historical data across all systems to create standardized patient data distributions, acting like a translation layer between different applications. Then we build a centralized index over it: a compressed representation that lets petabytes of raw data stay where it is while allowing us to search and reason across it as one system.
Industry: Healthcare
target:
Practice medicine, not administration.

AI operations for healthcare

Eos builds and runs operational and revenue-cycle workflows inside the systems your organization already uses.

From insurance and billing to referrals, scheduling, and patient follow-up, Eos adapts to how your team already works.

Healthcare data infrastructure

One infrastructure, fine-tuned for and by every deployment.

Eos makes customization scalable: every hospital gets a system built for them, and every deployment makes the next one better.

Your Eos

Work the way you already work.

Eos adapts across systems, workflows, specialties, and operating environments to fit your organization.

Harmonize healthcare data.

Eos is the predictive operating layer for healthcare practices. It unifies fragmented clinical and operational data, learns how each team runs, predicts where care and revenue-cycle workflows will break down, and executes the right intervention inside the systems they already use.

Unify silos

Reconstruct operational and clinical data across systems and time

Healthcare data lives in disconnected systems: EHRs, imaging archives, labs, scheduling, and billing, each using different identifiers and maintaining its own partial record.

Eos connects to these interfaces, resolves identities across sites and encounters, and links records into a continuous longitudinal history. The data itself stays in its original systems, but we can search and analyze distributed data as if it were one database.

Harmonize data

Make cases comparable

Clinical events are recorded differently across hospitals, scanners, and documentation styles. Without normalization, historical cases cannot be reliably compared.

Eos standardizes codes, imaging metadata, measurements, and documentation patterns into consistent patient trajectories, effectively acting as a translation layer between clinical applications.

VERA: Imaging Harmonization

Bring all modalities of medical imaging under a single standardized protocol.

LUCIA: Textual Harmonization

Structures EHRs from any system into a unified representation.

Models / agents in house

Your models and agents, running on your data

Eos hosts and runs your predictive models and operational agents in house, on top of the unified, harmonized record. You keep control of the models, the data stays in your environment, and inference happens where your systems already live.

Bring your own models, fine-tune on site-specific trajectories, or use Eos-built agents for eligibility, referrals, claims, and care coordination, all without shipping patient data to an external black box.

Predictive intelligence layer

From prediction to the full action

brief:

One-liner: Faster healthcare payments
Description: Syntra’s mission is to make healthcare faster, starting with healthcare payments. Syntra Autonomous, our first product, automates pre-bill chart review, claim review, and submission. In the 12 months since launch, Syntra Autonomous has processed more than 1 million patient encounters and over $200 million in insurance collections across hundreds of practice locations nationwide. If you’re interested in building toward infinitely fast healthcare, reach out!
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare IT
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, FinOps, Fintech, Healthcare IT
target:
Medical Chart Intelligence.

Agentic pre-bill chart and claim review and submission.

90 Day Audit to Automation

A measured, low-risk path from validation to autonomous pre-bill review. Click any day to explore the journey.

Audit

Observe + Establish Baseline

Establish Guidelines

Begin controlled automation

Validate

Expand Proven Workflows

Automate

Autonomous on eligible encounters

Every practice begins with a complimentary retroactive audit of recent charts and claims. See missed revenue, documentation gaps, coding variation, and compliance risk before you commit to anything.

What is pre-bill review?

Syntra reviews every chart before submission, so billing teams stop chasing claims that have already gone out the door.

What financial impact has Syntra shown?

Anonymized 37-location ophthalmology group in New York, measured in 2025. Results below are from production use of Syntra pre-bill review.

Equivalent to ~1.5 additional providers in collections capacity, without adding headcount.

How does autonomous pre-bill review work?

Agentic pre-bill chart and claim review, then submission, with humans in the loop where it still matters.

Revenue Discovery

Capture missed coding opportunities across 100% of charts. Increase average payment per CPT code by $3-5 with autonomous pre-bill review.

Outpatient Coding

CPC-level review of CPT and ICD-10 before claims go out. Trained with real medical coders.

Compliance

Full chart and claim audit coverage with no increase in headcount cost.

Risk Adjust

Identify global period risk and adjust payments for risk-adjusted payment models.

We integrate with your EHR.

We plug into your existing EHR, PM, and related systems out of the box. If yours isn't supported yet, we'll assign a dedicated engineer to build a custom integration for your clinic.

From the blog.

How a 12-Provider Ophthalmology Group Recovered $340K in Missed Charges

A retroactive audit across 18 months of charts uncovered systematic undercoding in office visits and missed testing charges. Here’s how the practice turned that around.

What the 2026 E/M Guideline Updates Mean for Specialty Practices

CMS continues to refine medical decision making criteria. We break down the changes that matter most for specialty clinics and what to update in your coding workflows.

The State of AI in Revenue Cycle Management: What We’re Seeing in 2026

From pre-bill review to denial prediction, AI adoption in the revenue cycle has moved from pilot projects to production. Here’s where the industry actually stands.

name: Spark
brief:
Product: Spark
One-liner: AI-powered workflows for energy infrastructure
Description: Spark AI is workflow software for solar, storage, and data center developers. We've reviewed and identified over 1 million zoning, permitting, and project-related documents in nearly every jurisdiction in America, so that you can instantly identify project requirements, local sentiment, and fatal flaws in seconds. We’re trusted by dozens of industry-leading developers representing over 90 gigawatts of project pipeline and $30 billion in financing.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Energy Storage, Solar Power, Climate, Energy, AI
target:
Permitting Intelligence for Energy Infrastructure & Data Centers

Agentic workflows for permitting, competitive intelligence, and community sentiment in seconds. Every county monitored, so nothing catches you off guard.

Trusted by Leading Energy Infrastructure & Data Center Developers

Metrics from leading energy developers on Spark

Trusted by leading energy infrastructure and data center developers

Deployment Intelligence Engine

Evaluate sites, navigate permitting requirements, track community sentiment, and monitor changes in real time

Selection

Assess prospective sites based on land use and past projects

Requirements

Extract permitting feasibility from zoning ordinances and moratoria

Interpretation

Derive community sentiment from local authorities, town hall meetings, and social media

Workflows

Accelerate portfolio and M&A diligence with automated analysis

End-to-End Site Screening, Diligence & Risk Analysis

From first screen to groundbreaking, and everything that changes after.

Planning & Zoning Reports

Every permit, every agency, every cost across federal, state, and local.

Document Diligence

Tired of "Ctrl+F" on hundreds of pages of complex policies and data rooms? Spark extracts answers instantly

Bulk Screening

Expedite screening by filtering through hundreds of markets and parcels at once

Monitoring & Alerts

Set an alert on any of 3,000+ U.S. counties. Get notified the moment zoning, moratoria, or sentiment changes near your site.

Developer Testimonials: Faster Decisions, Better Site Outcomes

How best-in-class developers accelerate their projects with Spark

Built by Experts in Energy Infrastructure & AI Software

Our team hails from top technology + energy companies and academic institutions

FAQ

How is Spark different from other siting tools?

Spark is not just site screening. It's permitting + zoning + local sentiment intelligence you use alongside GIS and mapping tools: Spark answers "can we actually get this built here?" with evidence-backed outputs (ordinance language, moratoria, process steps, red flags), not just a score.

Core differences:

ChatGPT is a general-purpose LLM optimized for drafting and summarizing. Spark is a domain-specific system engineered for deterministic coverage, verifiability, and scale—with persistent corpuses, citations, timestamps, and gap-reporting when something can't be found.

How fresh is the data (how often do you scrape/crawl)?

Spark crawls multiple times per week, continuously scanning authoritative public sources (AHJ sites, agendas/minutes, filings, local news) and storing each finding with a citation and timestamp.

Nationwide coverage across all 50 U.S. states, down to county and township levels (where online public-source presence exists).

name: Klaimee
brief:
Product: Klaimee
One-liner: Liability insurance for AI Agents. You deploy agents, we cover you.
Description: Klaimee is the first insurance for your AI agents. It covers what traditional E&O and cyber explicitly carve out, so you can deploy agentic AI at scale with real peace of mind. Built for companies deploying agentic AI, self-serve from day one. The problem: AI agents are taking actions autonomously buying, emailing, modifying sensitive data. AB 316 already holds deployers liable. EU AI Act enforces in August. Cyber and E&O insurance are excluding AI claims.
Industry: Fintech / Insurance
target:
Insure your agent. Get covered, fast.

Structured evaluation · Rapid turnaround

See Klaimee in action

Two kinds of harm. We cover both.

When an AI agent goes wrong, the damage lands in one of two places.

The agent harmed someone else

A customer, a partner, a member of the public. They bring a claim against you. Klaimee covers the liability and the cost of defending it.

The agent harmed you

It corrupted your records, made a bad internal transaction, or took down your own systems. There's no one to sue. The loss is yours, and Klaimee covers it.

The simple test: did the AI hurt a customer, or did it hurt you ?

What we insure: three real examples.

The kind of AI agent we cover, and what happens when it goes wrong.

AI voice agent for debt collection

A startup sells an AI voice agent that phones people to recover unpaid debts. On a call, the agent misstates a balance or breaks a collection rule.

AI customer-support agent

An AI support agent promises a customer a refund or a policy that doesn't exist. The customer relies on it and holds the company to it.

Internal AI operations agent

An enterprise runs an AI agent with write access to its own systems. The agent deletes production data or corrupts internal records.

Built for two kinds of company.

Whether you sell AI agents or run them inside your business, the exposure is real, and coverable.

Companies that build and sell AI agents

Enterprise procurement and legal won't sign off on an AI agent without proof of coverage. Klaimee gives them exactly what they're looking for: a certificate and a real counterparty for the risk, so your deal clears review instead of stalling.

Companies deploying AI agents in their own operations

When the agent damages your data, systems, or finances, Klaimee covers the loss. No third party required.

Where we focus today: B2B companies, bounded use cases, non-safety-critical. We don't insure autonomous vehicles, robotics, or physical-world safety systems.

Your AI agent isn't covered by the insurance you already have.

Most companies assume an existing policy has them covered. For autonomous AI agents, it doesn't.

Covers a hacker breaking into your systems. It does not cover your AI agent making a wrong decision on its own.

Covers a bug in software a human wrote. It does not cover the autonomous actions an AI agent takes.

name: Hatchways
brief:
Product: Hatchways
One-liner: We make engineering interviewing look more like real work.
Description: Easily customize GitHub-based technical assessments, where candidates can complete tasks like reviewing code, submitting a pull request, or improving a system’s design. Hatchways helps you build a state-of-the-art practical interview process that is customized to your role while saving you engineering interview load along the way.
Industry: B2B / Recruiting and Talent
Tags: B2B, Workflow Automation, Recruiting, HR Tech, Talent Acquisition
target:
Real-world Technical Interviews

Easily assemble, send and track assessments via git repos. Get better hiring signal and save time with Hatchways.

"Hatchways stood out to us as one of the few interviewing platforms that provided customizable interviews for each company based on factors that studies have shown provides the most equitable and inclusive interviewing experience possible."

Finally, the interview process you wanted

Superior Candidate Experience

Simplify your interviews with Hatchways. Skip the stressful, unrealistic tests and let candidates show their skills with real tasks like submitting a pull request or reviewing code.

Fast-Track Assessment Design

Easily craft assessments using our templates or upload your own . Benefit from our tried-and-true templates, informed by data and industry expertise. Offer code challenges in any language and select from tasks like bug fixes, feature additions, code reviews, and written or video responses.

Streamline Your Grading Process

Grade submissions with ease using Hatchways' robust tools—from automated tests to instant cloud deployments of candidate's submissions. Alternatively, leverage our human reviewers to spend less time reviewing and more time closing the right candidates!

Give the Candidate Experience You Wish You Had

The approach is unique and easy to work with. And the overall test doesn't bombard the developer with crazy questions but in an elegant way shows the developer's prowess

Subscript

Fun interesting coding problem that I enjoyed working on! Would love to work for a company with these kinds of challenges

Airtable

This is pretty amazing. It was the best assessment experience I had by far. The way it is integrated with GitHub, the UI, the setup. Great job!

LibLab

You're amazing test was one of the best I've ever had. It gave the opportunity to show what I can do without being too dramatic

This was a great way to test a candidates ability to perform job related coding activities versus unrelated programming questions done live.

Anonymous

I found out the assessment was really covering many different aspects of developers' knowledge and not just the API coding part, I am really interested in knowing more about the minds behind this challenge

Clipboard Health

Great choice of problem. Complexity of the problem really justified my technical skills. Companies now a days focuses more on DSA rather than technical skills. Testing skills are as important as DSA.

The challenge was compelling and represents a real challenge an engineer might face in day-to-day work.

name: Crosslayer Labs
brief:
Product: Crosslayer Labs
One-liner: Protect, monitor and defend your Internet presence
Description: Crosslayer Labs detects impersonation attacks on websites and APIs. We provide "outside-in" monitoring of customer infrastructure, comprehensively discovering and monitoring all Internet dependencies, including DNS, BGP, TLS certs, Javascript. We correlate signals from different layers of the Internet stack to identify attack patterns. Our alerts are actionable and contain root cause analysis/remediation recommendations.
Industry: B2B / Security
target:
Securing web infrastructure

Companies and enterprises across the world rely on the web for secure operations. We protect them from ongoing website and API hijacks.

Backed By

Trust the team that already secured 500 million+ HTTPS websites

The Crosslayer Labs founding team invented Multi-Perspective Issuance Corroboration which now secures the issuance of every HTTPS certificate .

Comprehensive Protection

We discover, analyze, and monitor all layers of network infrastructure on first and third-party services.

Advanced Threat Detection

We correlate signals across different layers of the network stack to neutralize threats.

Our Security Solutions

Our platform delivers the most critical security solutions all in one place.

Attack Surface Discovery

Understand the attack surface of APIs and web services to cyber attacks.

Security Analytics

Advanced threat intelligence and analytics to identify patterns and prevent attacks before they happen.

Ongoing Monitoring

Monitoring and correlating attack signals across layers for rapid response and mitigation.

Trust top network security research.

Our company was born out of a cutting edge network security research lab at Princeton University by some of the world experts in understanding threats to web services.

Meet Our Team

Our team of security experts brings decades of combined experience in network security, threat intelligence, and cybersecurity research.

Henry Birge-Lee

Founder & CEO

Computer security researcher at Princeton University whose standards and technology shaped the entire certificate authority industry.

Grace Cimaszewski

Founder & CTO

A graduate student at Princeton University who built global frameworks to understand the threat surface of millions of websites.

Dr. Prateek Mittal

Founder & Chief Scientist

Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering at Princeton University specializing in network AI security.

Industries We Secure

A broad range of industries have exposure to web infrastructure attacks which can lead to billions in losses . Some of these industries include:

Healthcare

Healthcare depends on web services to securely deliver and protect data. Attacks on web infrastructure can lead to unauthorized data access, data loss, and ransomware.

Cryptocurrency

Cryptocurrencies companies are some of the most common victims of web infrastructure attacks leading to the largest unrecoverable losses.

Banking/Fintech

Modern fintech is has become increasingly reliant in HTTPS connections to users or automated financial systems. We protect this critical backbone.

Get Started

Ready to secure your network? Schedule a demo to learn more about our platform.

[email protected]

name: Momo Medical
brief:
Product: Momo Medical
One-liner: We help nurses in nursing homes to be 30% more effective
Description: We go to nursing homes, and we put an internet-connected bed sensor underneath all their beds. Our app gives nurses valuable insights and an overview of all their residents. We reduce fall incidents and bedsores while improving evening and night shift productivity by over 30%. Momo Medical solves the biggest problem affecting nursing homes, staff shortages while increasing the quality of care.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: SaaS, IoT, B2B
target:
A calmer workfIow for personalized care

What do caregivers see?

What is the Momo App?

Change the workflow to relieve workload

Current workflow

Doing rounds

Momo workflow

More personalized care for residents

The BedSense makes a substantial contribution to working more effectively. The enthusiasm in the workplace is enormous.

Results

Based on research in multiple skilled nursing facilities

Who is working with us?

For colleagues and residents

For the overnight shift

For residents

For nursing staff

For the clinical manager

Stories of caregivers

At one glance I can see my entire department and I see everyone lying in their bed, that gives me so much peace. That feeling cannot be described in words.

Residents are more active and less agitated during the day because they sleep better. One resident also started to eat by himself again, we no longer need to help him with that.

It has given me the peace of mind to stay longer with a terminal resident, while still having an overview of the other residents and knowing that they were okay.

We take the app onto the medicine cart in the morning. We'll see who's awake and then we'll go straight there. Then we don't have to wake up the residents for their medication.

Stories of families

Great job! What a wonderful asset in helping to keep our loved ones safe.

target:
The document chase isn’t your job anymore.

DokuTrak collects your clients’ documents, follows up when they go quiet, and flags the wrong files. You make the final call.

name: Agave
brief:
Product: Agave
One-liner: AI Financial Operations for Construction
Description: We're building the financial ops platform for construction, a $12T global industry run by software built 20-40 years ago, much of it on-prem with no APIs and no documentation. We spent 3 years building the rails to read and write across those systems, and we use them to deploy AI for invoicing, expenses, compliance, billing, and more. We have 500+ customers and have been profitable & cashflow positive for over two years.
Industry: B2B
Tags: SaaS, Construction, B2B, Proptech
target:
Build without blind spots

Agave connects your construction systems, streamlines accounting workflows with AI, and delivers real-time financial visibility to the field and back-office.

Purpose-built AI for construction accounting

From standalone products to a complete financial operations platform, Agave keeps your field and finance teams always in sync.

ERP Sync

AP Invoice Automation

Expense Management

Vendor Compliance

Seamless integrations with your existing systems

With access to gated endpoints and native support for legacy and modern construction platforms, Agave delivers reliable integrations other tools can’t.

Three reasons general and trade contractors choose Agave

Job costing, cost codes, commitments and more. Agave speaks construction accounting natively, so your team stops forcing generic tools to fit construction accounting workflows.

Your ERP is the backbone of your business. Agave layers on top of your ERP to automate financial workflows, no rip-and-replace required.

AI learns how records are coded, how approvals are routed, and how job costs flow through your business—then automates those workflows across every project.

Automated accounting workflows for thousands of contractors

$ 27 B

$ 130 M

Meet the contractors who build with Agave

"It has been a huge help in our company in regards to efficiency and getting two unrelated systems to communicate. Agave has saved us a ton of time."

“Agave is freeing up everyone from mundane tasks. It's doing the repetitive work so our people can focus on higher-value decisions.”

“Agave lets us choose where jobs originate....We keep all the history without clogging the ERP. That flexibility completely changed how we start and manage jobs.”

"Before Agave, the data wasn’t reliable enough to act on. Now it is, and that directly impacts how we manage jobs and protect margin.”

“Agave gives you so many tools to control and manipulate your data. Knowing I can speed it up or slow it down...until I’m confident everything is right, that’s huge.”

Get real-time financial visibility across every job

See how Agave helps your team automate accounting, close the books faster, and always know where every job stands.

name: Cova
brief:
Product: Cova
One-liner: Financial infrastructure for family caregiving
Description: Cova is an AI-native home care agency, licensed in Michigan. We serve Medicaid, LTCI, and private-pay patients; we pay caregivers the highest base rate in the state; and we help unpaid family caregivers get paid through programs they didn't know they qualified for. Our entire operation runs on AI agents, which means less overhead and more value passed directly to the people doing the real work.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Consumer Health Services, Healthcare, AI
target:
Covered Anywhere , Covered Always .

Home care from the people who love you, and the highest pay for the people who give it. Covered by Medicaid.

Choose your path

Two ways in, both covered by Medicaid. Pick the one that fits, and we'll take it from there.

Simple from the first step

Getting started takes minutes, and Cova does the heavy lifting from there.

Tell us about you

Pick your path — giving care or needing it — then share a few quick details. It takes minutes, and there is nothing to prepare beforehand.

We handle the paperwork

Eligibility, enrollment, Medicaid billing, timesheets. Cova does all of it, so nobody in the family has to become an expert on it.

Care begins

You keep caring for the person you were always going to care for — and start getting paid for it, on a schedule that fits your week.

Built so everyone comes out ahead

Most home care sends a stranger into the house and pays them as little as it can. Cova pays the person already there.

Thanks for giving me an opportunity just to focus on my mother.

I told my old agency I was moving to Cova, because I was proud of where I was going. I'm so happy!

I've been an unpaid caregiver for 18 years. I love this company! I'm happy to be here.

Nothing but professionalism and kindness. Always there for any questions asked. I've recommended Cova to families knowing they will be in great hands.

Your company, Cova, has done more in 2 days than the agency I was at did in a month!

Hover a face to hear from them.

Real words from Cova caregivers. Faces changed for privacy.

Family gets paid every week

The care a son, a sister, or a neighbor already gives is real work. Cova pays at the top of the rate for it.

Care stays at home

No stranger on a schedule and no move to a facility. Care comes from the person who was always going to give it.

Covered by Medicaid

If the person you care for has Medicaid, the care is paid for. Nothing comes out of the family's pocket.

Trained and supported

Ongoing training and a hands-on support team keep care consistent and standards high, at no extra cost.

We have answers

Everything you need to know before getting started.

name: Superlist — Task Management & To-Do List App for Work and Life
brief:
Product: Superlist — Task Management & To-Do List App for Work and Life
Description: From the creators of Wunderlist — the all-in-one task management app for to-do lists, notes, and projects. AI-powered productivity that replaces 5 apps. Free to start, works on Mac, Web, iOS & Android.
target:
Your work and your life, finally on the same list.

Flexible enough for project plans and meeting notes. Simple enough for groceries. One beautiful app for all of it.

Stop juggling five different apps. Superlist makes it simple to manage your entire life.

Plan your day

Schedule tasks, reminders and habits so you're ready for the day ahead.

Stay on top of work

Track projects, deadlines and meeting prep without getting overwhelmed.

Keep home in sync

Share grocery lists, chores and family reminders so nothing slips through the cracks.

Everyday superpowers. Superlist is light enough for daily routines but powerful enough for big plans.

Tasks + notes in one

Keep context where it belongs. Add notes or details directly to tasks so everything stays in one place.

Infinitely nested lists and subtasks

Break big goals into small steps. Organize projects with subtasks, layers, and checklists so you always know what's next.

Quick add from anywhere

Type or talk, jot down "Dentist Friday at 2pm" or say it with Talk, and Superlist makes sure you don't forget it.

Recurring tasks

Stay on top of habits and routines with reminders that repeat automatically, from daily workouts to monthly bills.

Widgets at a glance

Get ideas out of your head fast. Add tasks right from your home screen or lock screen without opening the app.

Coming from Todoist, Things, or TickTick?

The honest comparison:

Everything, in one place. Free forever to start.

Fair questions.

What does the free plan actually include?

Unlimited tasks and notes, 5 lists, sharing with up to 5 people, every platform. Free forever — not a trial.

Is there a Windows app?

Not yet — Windows users get the full web app at app.superlist.com. If a native app ships, it'll be in the changelog first.

Won't work and personal blur together?

Only if you want them to. The toggle hides any sphere — work, personal, your side project — with one switch, without moving anything.

Do the AI features read my private lists?

Only when you invoke them, and nothing is used for training. [Link plain-English privacy note.]

Start bringing balance back to your life.

Download for macOS

brief:
Product: HackerRank
One-liner: Change the world to value skills over pedigree
Description: At HackerRank, our mission is to change the world to value skills over pedigree. Thousands of companies use our AI-powered platform to hire next-gen developers based on what they can do - not just what’s on their resume. From hiring to upskilling, we help teams identify and grow technical talent at every stage of the developer journey. Over 26 million developers have joined the HackerRank Community to learn and certify their skills, practice interviewing, and discover relevant jobs.
Industry: B2B / Recruiting and Talent
Tags: Developer Tools, Recruiting
target:
Hire the next generation developer

We help thousands of companies hire and upskill the next generation of developers, and millions of developers to become one.

The future is human plus AI. We’ve entered a new era of software development where human and AI build together. This changes the skills you need as a developer, and the way companies engage, hire, and upskill technical talent. In short, this changes everything. name: Fira
brief:
Product: Fira
One-liner: Financial research platform for investment firms
Description: Fira accelerates financial research for investment analysts by instantly searching and analyzing thousands of pages of company filings and earnings reports, delivering source-cited answers and verifiable calculations. Our mission is to build a comprehensive research platform that integrates seamlessly with internal and external data sources, handles research and analysis, generates investment documents, and automates repetitive workflows.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
target:
AI Analyst for Finance

Delegate your financial research tasks

Drop files here

Trading comps analysis for Microsoft

Benchmark Microsoft against a peer set to generate Excel with EV bridges, trading multiples and summary stats. Derive implied valuation from peer medians

EqV-to-EV bridge for Nike

Calculate market cap and bridge Equity Value to Enterprise Value for Nike with all material balance sheet adjustments. All numbers sourced from latest SEC filings

Number verification for Evertec

Cross-references every number in Evertec's presentation against SEC filings and earnings releases for inconsistencies. View verification table with precise sources

How It Works

Don't let manual research slow you down.

Keeping up with every market, company, and data source was impossible. Fira brings it all together so you can ask questions and trust the answers.

Connect data

Start researching immediately with preloaded market data and public filings. Connect Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint, or Box to unlock Fira's full potential.

Ask and research

Analyze companies and markets across multiple sources and hundreds of complex financial documents. Built specifically for finance to understand long reports, Excel files and complex charts.

Verify and export

Every answer is grounded in evidence, with citations down to the exact cell or paragraph. Preview sources inline, verify with confidence, and export directly to Excel.

Research with confidence

Fira brings your internal documents, data rooms, and external datasets into a single AI workspace built for multi-document Q&A with auditable, cited answers.

Benchmark peer companies. Easily compare revenue, margins, and key metrics across multiple companies by pulling data directly from source filings.

Purpose-built for finance

Complex tables, nested spreadsheets, and hundreds of filings. Tools designed for how finance actually works.

Financial Document Processing

Generic AI falls short in high finance. Fira reads complex tables, nested sheets, and scanned documents with precision.

Granular Source Citations

Every answer grounded in evidence. Citations down to the specific cell, row, or paragraph. Built for the audit trail mindset.

Powerful Search at Scale

Seamlessly integrates internal and external data at any scale. Navigate thousands of PDFs, spreadsheets, and presentations with ease.

Financial Graphs

Understand complex data visually. Generate charts that meet the standards of top-tier banks, ready for client deliverables.

Instant P&L Extraction to Excel

Turn static PDFs into workable models. Copy-paste financials into Excel with formatting preserved.

Deep-Link Collaboration

Share evidence, not just conclusions. Direct links to specific paragraphs or tables. Perfect for model footnotes and client communication.

Data Sources

Unified Data Sources

name: Mach9
brief:
Product: Mach9
One-liner: AI CAD Software for Civil Engineering
Description: Mach9 accelerates how teams model and understand the world with automated feature extraction technology. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, Mach9's flagship Digital Surveyor platform helps transportation agencies, utility companies, and engineering firms extract miles of road corridor projects in a fraction of traditional processing time.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Design Tools, Infrastructure, AI
target:
Turn reality capture into complete deliverables faster

AI CAD software for civil engineering

Mach9 automatically drafts features from raw scans with centimeter-level accuracy at infrastructure scale. Your team fine-tunes and delivers.

Trusted by

Miles surveyed

Faster extraction per technician

Projects delivered

COLLECTING & PROCESSING A DATASET

TIME SPENT

Conventional surveying is only as fast as you can hire

A crew measures the site one point at a time, and everything has to be right before they leave. Miss a feature, and someone drives back out to get it.

Reality capture moved the bottleneck to the office

A mapping vehicle can scan a corridor in a day. Turning those scans into deliverables can still consume months of technician time and limits how much work a team can take on.

Mach9’s AI turns months of work into days

Mach9 drafts features from your raw scans at centimeter-level accuracy and flags what needs a second look. Your team spot-checks and finishes, letting them take on more, from a single site to an entire infrastructure network.

Automatically draft features from raw scans at centimeter-level accuracy and infrastructure scale

Step 1

Upload your scans to Mach9’s web-based CAD software. System agnostic by design. Import mobile, terrestrial, and drone reality capture data from the hardware you already use: Leica, Phoenix, RIEGL, Trimble, NavVis, and more.

Step 2

Our AI analyzes it and creates a first draft of features. Mach9 reads your point cloud and auto-detects the features you need: breaklines, curbs, striping, poles, signs, wires, and more.

Step 3

You fine-tune with Mach9's CAD tools. You accept a line, nudge a vertex, or draw manually where judgment matters. Built-in QC flags what needs review, so you can validate miles of extraction with confidence.

Step 4

Deliver: Export as DXF, DGN, Esri Feature Services, Geodatabase, JSON, Shapefile or field-to-finish survey formats. Deliverables that drop into your CAD and GIS workflows.

Built for the infrastructure work your team delivers

Turn corridor and site scans into design-ready linework and surfaces. QC tools let you control every deliverable.

Turn weeks of drafting into hours

Step 1 of 3

By continuing, you agree we may save your details to follow up. Privacy policy

name: StayQrious
brief:
Product: StayQrious
One-liner: StayQrious helps kids in India learn through online group classes,…
Description: Imagine doing personalised workouts with a fitness coach, but for school subjects. Students log into their session that has been scheduled with their coach, they can see their learning workout for the day. Their workout typically consists of watching an interactive video, writing explanations, giving feedback to other students, making an explainer video etc. They get constant feedback and encouragement from the coach and progress only after they have understood the pre-requisites.
Industry: Education
Tags: eLearning, India, Kids
target:
A school that teaches the skills that matter

The most successful people aren't the ones that memorised. They are the ones who can walk into something unfamiliar and don't freeze, because they have some skills that others don't.

Built by people from

Ex Head of Content, Khan Academy

Ex-Director of Learning, Stanford

StayQrious Neoschool is a Y Combinator -backed school, accredited by Cambridge . Students build the skills of the future and the subject knowledge by working on real projects, in small teams.

What we are

A school built for the world your child will actually inherit

The future is volatile, uncertain, complex, and ambiguous. Rote learning won't help navigate it, and you already know this. Children need to build real skills by solving real problems. They need a coach who nudges, challenges, and gives honest feedback, and not a teacher racing to finish a syllabus.

Why a small classroom

There's a reason for 8-member pods.

Eight learners and one coach. That's it. When the class size is small, everyone is seen and heard.

Your child, lost in the crowd

In a room of thirty

The loudest voice wins and everyone else remains invisible. Shy children learn to hide, and you'd never know whether they're struggling.

Your child, seen every single day

In a pod of eight

The coach knows their name on day one, and by week two knows whether they need a nudge or a moment.

OUR PROMISE

We teach for the life ahead, not just the test in front of them.

Durable skills, taught on purpose

Communication, collaboration, emotional resilience, the curiosity to keep asking and the grit to recover. These are the skills that actually make the difference in the world your child is growing into. Most schools hope these just happen. We don't leave it to hope.

Roughly 40% of a student's time with us is spent actively building them: in how the pod works together, how feedback is given, and how students present, disagree, and try again.

Academics, solidly covered

Math, Science, ELA and Computational Thinking are taught at every grade in a way that fits the age, and by Grade 10 we ensure students are prepared for IGCSE. Topics that carry the most dependencies later are taught in more depth and spiralled over time, built on year after year rather than rushed through once. Throughout, students learn by understanding rather than rote, so they can apply knowledge in the real world and build a genuine liking for each subject.

name: Blueshoe
brief:
Product: Blueshoe
One-liner: The AI-Native Consumer + Plaintiff Law Firm
Description: Blueshoe is a full-stack law firm that helps people with everything from everyday legal issues to high-stakes litigation and trial. People can access legal guidance directly through our web app or the AI interfaces where they are already seeking answers. If representation is needed, Blueshoe attorneys handle many cases all the way to resolution, equipped with cutting-edge data, AI-native tools, and operational support.
Industry: B2B / Legal
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Consumer, B2B, Legal, LegalTech
target:
Justice is leverage, not luxury.

Elite legal counsel used to require wealth or connections. Our mission is to bring it to everyone.

MEET BLUESHOE

A law firm unlike anything before. Smart. On-demand. For everyone.

Blueshoe connects you with a dedicated attorney for your legal matter. No billable hours. No gatekeepers. No nonsense.

Layoff resource center

Tracking major U.S. layoffs — with free guides for affected workers

Live WARN-filing tracker, event-by-event guides (Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, and more), and a free confidential severance assessment.

Fast to start, aligned to the finish

We never bill by the hour. Our only incentive is the best outcome for you, as fast as possible. Bring any question or concern, and you get streamlined intake and assessment, quick turnaround, and transparent pricing. We break out the exact costs, if any, at every stage, so you always know what to expect.

Service that leaves no stone unturned

Our legal intelligence keeps your entire matter in context. Every document, message, and decision. Purpose-built workflows find missing information, review, monitor and fix issues proactively, sending you regular progress updates so you stay informed without worrying about checking in.

Trusted attorneys, professional expertise

We ensure every matter is driven by seasoned attorneys with expertise in the relevant area of law, providing the human judgment, strategy, and craft that you deserve. Technology speeds the groundwork, but human professionals make the decisions on your matter.

Who we serve

Law for real people, not corner offices

Employment

Wrongful termination, discrimination, severance.

Medical & Injury

Malpractice, personal injury, insurance disputes.

Consumer & Financial

Debt collection, credit disputes, fraud, consumer protection.

Property & Construction

Purchases, closings, construction contracts, permits, disputes.

Product & Environment

Defective products, toxic exposure, and environmental contamination.

Creators & Founders

Brand deals, licensing, trademarks, IP, and the foundation to build on.

FOR ATTORNEYS

Great attorneys do their best work with us

“Blueshoe is a complete partner in the coming wave of generative AI and its impact on law. I get clients I can help. Back office support. I focus more on outcomes, and I get better results.”

Gage Mathers has a strong reputation as an aggressive, high-quality litigation law firm. Its team routinely appears on Arizona’s Top 10 verdicts list.

Our vision

Flexible Deployment

Managed cloud or your own AWS, GCP, Azure VPC.

Secure

Ephemeral VMs, complete isolation, no code access.

Built for scale

Unlimited job concurrency, fast local caching, and tools designed to support collaboration for 1000s of developers.

AI made writing code cheap. It did nothing to make building and testing it cheap. The bottleneck moved from the keyboard to the runner queue.

Every change is a pipeline

Each PR, each push, each rebase and retry fans out into the full build and test matrix. Velocity upstream lands as load downstream.

CI becomes the queue

brief:
Product: Bloom
One-liner: Investing app that teaches you how to invest
Description: Bloom's mission is to improve the financial outcomes of all Americans by giving them the knowledge and tools they need to achieve prosperity. Our first product is an investing app that teaches users how to build wealth through interactive financial lessons, a gamified rewards economy as well as an investing account designed for building long-term wealth. Since launching in April 2022, over 1 million users have joined Bloom and we have crossed $3MM in annual recurring revenue.
Industry: Fintech / Consumer Finance
Tags: Education, Fintech, Edtech
target:
Learn. Invest. Automate - Investing made easy, not complicated

Invest in Real stocks, ETFs and crypto.

Mirror Wall Street and Politicians' Portfolio

Learn investing fast, fun, and easy

Turn your ideas into portfolios

Ask Bloomie anything about investing

Play games and earn real rewards

Not Sure Where to Invest? Follow and Mirror Wall Street’s top bets.

You don't need to be a financial genius to invest well. Simply mirror the exact moves of Wall Street's most successful investors, automatically. No confusing charts, no risky guesses, just proven strategies from people who do this for a living.

Finally, Stock Market Education That Actually Makes Sense

No confusing jargon. No boring textbooks. Just clear, bite-sized lessons that teach you what you actually need to know—whether you're starting from zero or want to level up your investing game. Over 300 modules and 5,000+ lessons that adapt to YOUR experience level.

Master investing with 300+ beginner-friendly lessons

Learn investing through bite-sized lessons and quizzes updated every week. Stay sharp, level up, and keep your money game strong.

Ask Anything. Learn Everything.

Stocks, industries, trends, whatever you’re curious about. Bloomie breaks it down into short lessons you’ll actually get. Infinite learning. Zero gatekeeping.

Learn, Play, and Earn

Master investing through fun stock games and challenges. Compete, earn rewards, and grow your skills. All while having fun.

Start with any theme or belief about the market. From AI to clean energy, invest in ideas you really believe in.

Bloomie instantly turns your idea into a ready-to-invest portfolio, built and analyzed by Bloom’s scoring system.

View historical performance, stability, and diversification compared to the S&P 500.

Modify stocks and weightings, then add it to your holdings like a personal index fund.

Coming soon. Create shared portfolios and invest together with friends and family.

Ask anything about stocks, market trends, or portfolio strategy and get clear answers in seconds.

Learn Without the Jargon

Your 24/7 Pocket Wealth Manager

Ask questions, learn strategies, and invest confidently—all with AI guidance that adapts to your goals

Trusted by real investors and experts

Your journey starts here

We’re helping the next generation of investors grow their wealth — one lesson at a time.

The AI SRE for dynamic environments

An always-on, AI first responder that executes your best debugging practices the moment something breaks.

Turn in-house expertise into actionable, production-ready AI

Wild Moose codifies tribal knowledge to gather context across fragmented observability tools, delivering evidence-backed root causes and recommended next actions in real-time.

Hyper-personalized, accurate results engineers can trust

Company-aware AI learns your systems and incidents to diagnose faster

Alert enrichment

Wild Moose orchestrates a system of expert agents customized to your company to run reliable, end-to-end investigations.

Diagnose issues in seconds

Company-specific debugging agents work together

Debugging agents operate as a coordinated system, running investigations in parallel based on real-time signals.

name: Nivara
brief:
Product: Nivara
One-liner: AI agents for the finance back office.
Description: We’re building AI agents for finance teams. They handle repetitive work across email and accounting systems - processing documents, following up on open items, reconciling records, and resolving exceptions while people retain approval and oversight.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
Tags: B2B, AI
target:
Get paid faster.

Nivara's agents chase your unpaid invoices, clear the approvals and portals holding them up, and bring you in when a person is needed. On top of the systems you already run.

Reads and writes the systems you already run

The cost of doing it by hand

Average B2B days sales outstanding

B2B invoices paid after terms

Industry benchmarks, not Nivara results.

What we do

Agents that close the loop

Not copilots, not chat. They read the systems of record, take the action, and write back what they did.

Built for why it's late

An approval that stalled, a portal rejection nobody saw, a missing PO number, an AP contact who left. Reminders on a schedule don't fix any of those.

We run it, not just ship it

You're buying the work done, not a license and a login. Our team stands behind the agents, and anything that carries risk waits for your approval.

Why now

This work wasn't automatable two years ago. It is now.

The documents finally parse

Remittance advices, POs, freight bills, emailed disputes. Reading a scanned packet and pulling the right five fields stopped being a research project.

Multi-step work holds together

The job was never one lookup. It's pull the record, find the source document, check the terms, decide, then write it back. Agents now carry that chain without losing the thread.

The economics inverted

Teams staffed up on this work because software couldn't do it. Those analysts are still the ones who know why an exception is an exception — they just shouldn't be the ones opening every document to find it.

Where we work

Each of these is a queue that grows every month and never gets smaller. We take one, prove it against your volume in four weeks, and earn the next.

Collections

We work the aging ledger account by account, follow up until it clears, and track every promise to pay. You set the tone and the escalation rules once.

Approvals & AP portals

The real reason enterprise invoices sit unpaid. We submit into Coupa, Ariba, and custom portals, fix rejections, and chase the person who actually releases payment.

Disputes & short-pays

Every payment that doesn't match cleanly is a dispute nobody has looked at. We pull the PO, the receipt, and the rate, then hand your analyst a decision.

Cash application

Match incoming payments to open invoices across bank files, emailed advices, and PDF scans. Post what's clean, queue what isn't.

brief:
Product: InferEdge
One-liner: Agentic AI for buy-side firms
Description: InferEdge builds agentic AI for the buy-side - systems that run autonomously across research, portfolio management, and risk, for equity and fixed income. The point isn't generating a generic note - anyone can do that now. For example, when earnings season hits, our agents produce the quarter's coverage in your analysts' own tone and format, matching how your desk already writes, so it doesn't need a rewrite before it's usable.
Industry: Fintech
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Fintech, B2B, Enterprise Software, Investments
target:
Agentic solutions for investment teams.

InferEdge builds agentic AI for investment teams, capital markets and wealth firms - autonomous systems across research, portfolio management, risk, and distribution.

Compress the work, not the judgement

InferEdge doesn't replace judgment — it removes the reading. The hours spent in triage, synthesis, and cross-referencing get returned as time for actual calls.

AI agents that funds can trust.

Deploy AI that delivers reliable, consistent results, not just impressive demos. InferEdge helps asset managers automate complex research and decision workflows with AI that’s built for accuracy, transparency, and human oversight.

Monitor events and track risk in real-time.

Teams drown in information. InferEdge ingests the entire market surface — news, social, filings, transcripts, research — and surfaces only what moves your portfolio, with the "so what" already attached.

Built for the investment workflow.

Works with the stack you already have.

We're not a chat wrapper. We're infrastructure.

InferEdge is built by ex-analysts and systems engineers who know what actually ships in a regulated fund. We invested early in the hard parts — evals, citations, and control — because that's what separates a prototype from a system.

30-minute demo and walkthrough. Map your use-case, define an actual day to day workflow to pilot, and start seeing real impact within 1-2 days.

name: GovGuard
brief:
Product: GovGuard
One-liner: Automating Government Workflows, starting with FOIA
Description: Today, public records teams still spend hours searching for responsive records and applying redactions. Many offices still redact sensitive information line by line with a sharpie. Local governments spend billions processing these requests, and if a city misses a legal deadline, it can be sued for failing to comply with public records law.
Industry: Government
Tags: GovTech
target:
AI Infrastructure for Government Agencies

GovGuard is building AI agents that automate government workflows, starting with FOIA. We help agencies find responsive records, redact sensitive information, and draft responses.

The platform for FOIA discovery and response.

From request to redacted release.

Automatic Routing

Every request is routed to the right department by type, records, and prior handling automatically.

Discover Records

Find responsive records across email, documents, and shared systems, then ranked by relevance.

Redaction Flagging

AI agents detect PII and sensitive content, suggest redactions, and map each of them to statutory exemptions.

Drafting Agent

Generate a ready-to-send response letter with the correct exemptions and citations, built for clerks, by clerks.

Audit Trail

Every search, redaction, decision, and draft is logged with timestamps for complete audit transparency.

Frequently Asked

Our system connects securely to your city's archives. When a request comes in, our agents pinpoint relevant documents, auto-redact sensitive information, and draft the response letter for city staff.

Yes. GovGuard is built with enterprise-grade security standards. We encrypt all data at rest and in transit, and strictly isolate organization data. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of data privacy for municipalities and are working towards SOC2 certification.

Yes. GovGuard drafts each response letter using your jurisdiction's templates and tone, and city staff can edit any draft before it goes out. Every citation and exemption is included automatically, so the letter is ready for review.

We ingest a wide variety of file types including emails, PDFs, documents, and spreadsheets. These are pulled seamlessly from standard municipal platforms including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, YouTube, Zoom, etc.

Our agents flag content that falls under specific FOIA exemptions and cite the relevant statute for each suggested redaction. City staff approve the final set before anything is released.

Yes. You retain full ownership and control of all records and metadata. We never train our models on your city's private data.

Ready to automate your FOIA compliance?

GovGuard connects to your city's archives, surfaces responsive records, auto-redacts sensitive information, and drafts statutory response letters.

Description: Today, public records teams still spend hours searching for responsive records and applying redactions. Many offices still redact sensitive information line by line with a sharpie. Local governments spend billions processing these requests, and if a city misses a legal deadline, it can be sued for failing to comply with public records law.
Industry: Government
Tags: GovTech

AI Infrastructure for Government Agencies

GovGuard is building AI agents that automate government workflows, starting with FOIA. We help agencies find responsive records, redact sensitive information, and draft responses.

The platform for FOIA discovery and response.

From request to redacted release.

Automatic Routing

Every request is routed to the right department by type, records, and prior handling automatically.

Discover Records

Find responsive records across email, documents, and shared systems, then ranked by relevance.

Redaction Flagging

AI agents detect PII and sensitive content, suggest redactions, and map each of them to statutory exemptions.

Drafting Agent

Generate a ready-to-send response letter with the correct exemptions and citations, built for clerks, by clerks.

Audit Trail

Every search, redaction, decision, and draft is logged with timestamps for complete audit transparency.

Frequently Asked

Our system connects securely to your city's archives. When a request comes in, our agents pinpoint relevant documents, auto-redact sensitive information, and draft the response letter for city staff.

Yes. GovGuard is built with enterprise-grade security standards. We encrypt all data at rest and in transit, and strictly isolate organization data. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of data privacy for municipalities and are working towards SOC2 certification.

Yes. GovGuard drafts each response letter using your jurisdiction's templates and tone, and city staff can edit any draft before it goes out. Every citation and exemption is included automatically, so the letter is ready for review.

We ingest a wide variety of file types including emails, PDFs, documents, and spreadsheets. These are pulled seamlessly from standard municipal platforms including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, YouTube, Zoom, etc.

Our agents flag content that falls under specific FOIA exemptions and cite the relevant statute for each suggested redaction. City staff approve the final set before anything is released.

Yes. You retain full ownership and control of all records and metadata. We never train our models on your city's private data.

Ready to automate your FOIA compliance?

GovGuard connects to your city's archives, surfaces responsive records, auto-redacts sensitive information, and drafts statutory response letters.

target:
The Operating System for Airlines

One system for inventory, booking, check-in, and revenue - built for airlines that want full control.

What full control actually looks like

Legacy PSS vendors fragment your margin across booking, distribution, and ops. Farel is built as one, not stitched together.

Proven in real airline operations

Live with carriers across 4 continents. Built on the standards that define what's next in aviation.

Live on 4 continents

From LATAM to Central Asia - airlines running live flights on Farel every day.

Certified & Secure

Security built for airline payments and passenger data.

IATA-native

Aligned with IATA One Order and built API-first for next-gen airline architecture.

Backed by Y Combinator and leading global investors

Works with your airports, your PSPs, your regulators

Farel integrates with airports, payment providers, and regulatory systems out of the box, so you don't build middleware.

Airport compatible

Connects to any airport check-in and ground environment.

Regulatory connected

Compliant data transmission to authorities worldwide.

Any payment provider

Process payments through any PSP, any currency, any method.

No surprises. From pricing to go-live

Transparent terms, fast onboarding, and support that doesn't disappear after signing.

Transparent pricing

Pay per boarded passenger. Features, training, regulatory transmissions - all included. Your cost scales with your traffic, nothing more.

Predictable implementation

Most airlines go live in 2-8 weeks with a dedicated onboarding team. We handle migration, testing, and training - on a fixed timeline.

Low transition risk

Proven migration playbook from legacy PSS. Parallel run options, rollback plans, zero-downtime cutover, and no long-term lock-in.

Built for growth

Add routes, fleets, and stations without re-platforming. Farel scales with your airline, from 2 aircraft to 200.

Ready to take back control?

See the full platform live - tailored to your airline's operations.

target:
AI Tech Packs in 10 Minutes

Replaces Excel + Illustrator with one easy to edit techpack: specs, measurements, and BOM, ready to share with your factory.

AI builds the first draft. Your team controls the final pack.

AI Tech Packs turns the original garment image, sizing, and design brief into an editable first draft. Your team then runs Techpack Mama to flag details that may need attention, finishes the pack in the editor, saves the approved version, and exports or shares it with the factory.

Bring in the design

Upload a garment photo, sketch, or flat. Start with one style, or use Batch Workspace to queue 2–10 with shared defaults.

Get the first draft in 10 minutes

AI assembles flat sketches, initial specs, measurements, materials, construction details, and placements into an editable tech pack.

Catch issues faster with Techpack Mama

Run Techpack Mama after generation to compare the pack with the original garment image, size setup, and design brief. She brings the details that may need attention into one review, so your team enters the editor knowing where to focus.

Techpack Mama

Real product workflow

Finish the pack in the editor

Edit measurements, materials, construction, placements, colorways, and the pages your team needs before final approval.

Factory Share

One current link · pack or full collection

Approve and hand off

After your team approves the pack, export PDF or Excel or send one current Factory Share link for the pack or full collection. The factory can move between styles without an account, and updates stay on the same link.

Keep the whole collection moving from draft to factory

Collections gives design, sourcing, and quality teams one shared view of every tech pack in the line. Organize styles, track production status, and keep approved packs moving toward factory handoff as the collection grows.

Bring the collection into one view

Organize saved tech packs by collection and style so the team works from the same production view.

See every production stage

See where each pack stands, from draft and review through sampling and approval.

Keep production moving

Use custom statuses, filters, and bulk updates to make the next action clear across the collection.

Open the current pack for review and editing, then export PDF or Excel or create a Factory Share link after approval.

Collection workspace

Every style and production status in one view

Full collection

Grows with your line

Custom workflow

Draft to factory handoff

name: Stacksync
brief:
Product: Stacksync
One-liner: Real-time and two-way sync between CRMs and Databases
Description: Stacksync powers real-time and bidirectional data synchronization between CRMs (e.g. Salesforce, Hubspot or SAP) and databases (e.g. Postgres, Google BigQuery,...). Edits made in your CRM will instantly update in your Database, and vice-versa. To set up a sync, users simply have to connect the two chosen apps in one click and select the tables they want to sync, no-code!
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
target:
AI Agents & Integrations for complex enterprise processes.

Genies keep humans in the loop, only when they are needed. Operate across any system, including tools without APIs. Keep full control, traceability, and security built in.

Independently audited and certified across the security and privacy frameworks enterprise teams require.

Built for teams where self-serve, reliability and scale matter

Genies operate across 1,000+ native integrations.

E-commerce

Sync orders, inventory, and customers across Shopify, NetSuite, and your CRM.

Order-to-cash automation

Propagate Shopify orders to NetSuite, QuickBooks, and your CRM in milliseconds. No nightly batch.

Real-time inventory sync

Bidirectional stock levels across warehouse, Shopify, and Amazon Seller Central with field-level conflict rules.

Returns and refunds

One workflow drives the refund through Stripe, accounting, 3PL, and customer notifications.

Marketplace federation

Aggregate listings, orders, and shipping events across 14 marketplaces under one schema.

Customer 360 in your CRM

Unify Shopify customers, Klaviyo events, and Zendesk tickets into a single HubSpot or Salesforce record.

Subscription billing sync

Recurring orders, dunning, and upgrades sync between Stripe Billing, NetSuite, and Shopify in real time.

Wholesale & B2B portal

Net-terms orders, price lists, and approvals flow from your B2B portal to ERP without manual rekey.

Fraud signals to checkout

Risk scores from Stripe Radar and Signifyd push to checkout and CRM before fulfilment kicks off.

Anyone at your company can leverage AI. What will you build today?

Simple for business users. Built for complex enterprise processes.

A Genie is an always-on AI worker that operates across your enterprise systems even when there is no API. Agents own outcomes, set their own reminders, run multi-agent teams until the job is done, not only a chatbot.

Cross-system processes

1,000+ native connectors.

Even when there is no API, Stacksync logs into a browser session, clicks through like a human, and finishes the job.

Interact with Genies from anywhere

Chat, Email, Slack, Teams, and API.

Same Genie, any surface. Start a request in Slack, escalate over email, audit it through the API.

Human in the loop

Approve, edit, or override before Genies act.

Pause on policy-defined steps. Reviewer sees the diff, signs off, and the run resumes.

Always-running agents

Agents that own outcomes, not chatbots you prompt

Genies create their own reminders, schedule follow-ups, and run multi-agent teams until work is complete.

Control everything

Feature access policy. Access control. Audit logs.

Approve, edit, or override before Genies act.

Pause on policy-defined steps. Reviewer sees the diff, signs off, and the run resumes.

Always-running agents

Agents that own outcomes, not chatbots you prompt

Genies create their own reminders, schedule follow-ups, and run multi-agent teams until work is complete.

Control everything

Feature access policy. Access control. Audit logs.

brief:
Product: Glowing.io
One-liner: Unified, enterprise messaging platform for leading brands of the world
Description: Glowing enables leading global brands and their customers to text message with each other via existing popular mobile messaging platforms. Our solution allows for brands to appeal to millennials (and other digital travelers) as well as to the “silent guests” who prefer messaging as their primary communication channel.
Industry: B2B
Tags: SaaS, B2B, Messaging
target:
The AI-powered messaging platform that speaks every guest's language

For Hospitality Leaders

From WhatsApp and WeChat to Instagram and Zalo, Glowing unifies every guest conversation with real-time translation in one platform — making omni-channel engagement simple, on-brand, and scalable.

Trusted by globally-admired luxury brands

The Problem

Multi-channel, multilingual chaos burns out hospitality teams — and your guests feel it

Too Many Channels

Disconnected communication drains time, creates confusion, and forces reactive instead of proactive service.

Language barriers damage trust

When teams can’t reply clearly or quickly, communication breaks — causing delays and guest frustration.

Missed moments = lost revenue

Without smart, automated messaging, staff miss critical chances to upsell, personalize, or intervene.

The Solution

Meet Glowing

The AI-powered guest engagement platform that unifies messaging, automates the busywork, and delivers luxury experiences at scale.

Manage every conversation in one place – across any channel

Handle all guest conversations — SMS, WhatsApp, WeChat, LINE, Facebook Messenger, and more — in one cloud-based dashboard. No more juggling platforms or losing context. Intelligent private routing ensures every message reaches the right team instantly.

Remove language barriers and stay on-brand with real-time translation + AI Copilot

Respond to guests in 100+ languages with seamless two-way translation. Your team writes in their language — guests receive it in theirs. AI Copilot keeps replies clear, on-brand, and correct, and can draft or auto-respond when your team is busy.

brief:

One-liner: Turn manual healthcare process into automated workflows
Description: We help large provider groups and hospitals take their most mundane repetitive tasks and turn them into automated workflows. Freeing up healthcare workers to focus on the important stuff, like patients

AI that removes bottlenecks without adding staff. Shift Agents replace fragmented processes with seamless execution from intake to payment—no dropped tasks, no revenue leaks

AI for Transforming Healthcare Operations

End-to-end automation from referral to reimbursement—no manual handoffs, no delays.

Resolve patient inquries 24/7

brief:
Product: Amby Health
One-liner: The health coach that texts you first
Description: Your wearable tells you what happened. Amby texts you what to do next, checks in, and adjusts when life gets in the way.
Industry: Healthcare / Consumer Health and Wellness
Tags: SaaS, Health Tech, Digital Health, Healthcare, Health & Wellness
target:
The coach that texts you first.

Amby reads your training from Strava, Garmin, and Apple Health, then checks in at the moments that matter.

TODAY 6:42 AM

62 ms +4

Most coaching apps wait. Amby texts first.

No dashboard to remember to open, no check-in forms to fill out. Amby watches your training and starts the conversation. You just text back.

Legs feeling ready for tonight's intervals? Sleep and HRV say yes.

Session at 6. Start topping up carbs now, not at 5:30.

Resting HR ran high yesterday. Say the word and we go easier tonight.

Strava just synced. Negative split, nice. Want me to log how it felt and mark today complete?

Set up once. Coached every day.

Connect your data

Link Strava, Garmin, or Apple Health in a tap. Amby reads the training, sleep, and recovery you already track. No new wearable to buy.

Get a coach in your texts

Amby texts you a plan, answers your questions, and checks in on its own, over the messages app you already use all day.

Open the app when you want

Your plan, activity history, and recovery trends live in the iOS and web apps. Optional: the coaching comes to you.

Coaching in your texts. Everything else, one tap away.

The same coach, the same plan, everywhere you look.

iMessage / SMS

Where the coaching happens. Ask anything, log sessions, get check-ins. Every change is confirmed with you first.

Tempo tomorrow looks risky. Sleep was short two nights running. Swap in an easy 40 minutes?

yes, swap it

Athlete app

Today's session, your activity history, and your recovery trends in your pocket.

Web app

The same training home on a big screen, for when you want to spread the map out. In private beta.

Know when to push, and when to rest.

Recovery, training load, and consistency on one panel, so hard days land when your body is ready for them.

Sleep, HRV, and resting heart rate, tracked every day.

Acute vs. chronic load

Acute load tracking just above your base. Acute (7-day) load against chronic (28-day) fitness. The shaded band is the safe ramp, so it's easy to see when you're drifting above it.

Show up. Watch it stack.

An 11-week streak. Consistency is the engine.

No autopilot. You approve everything.

Amby works from your real data and remembers your history, but nothing is saved, shared, or changed until you say so.

One-liner: AI-native office leasing broker
Description: The pandemic reduced office use nationwide by 50%, and tenants have been left to deal with highly inflexible, long term lease agreements that don’t fit today’s office use patterns. The traditional brokerage model works great for big spaces and long terms. But when you want to talk smaller units, short term lengths, shared and common areas, you’re out of luck. Full-market access. Next-day tours. Expert negotiation.

Apollo AI

Move faster

From shortlist to site visit, we coordinate every conversation and follow-up — so you're not chasing emails or juggling calendars.

name: Chamber
brief:
Product: Chamber
One-liner: The AIOps Agent for ML Teams
Description: Chamber puts your AI infrastructure on autopilot, and saves your machine learning engineers hours of manual effort. Our agents continually monitor, detects failures, provide root-cause analysis, resolve issues, and optimize AI workloads and scale across clouds. It operates like an autonomous infrastructure team, helping save your research and engineers hours each day, and debugging workload performance issues. Your ML teams move faster, infra waste drops, and GPU bottlenecks disappear.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
target:
AIOps agents for ML teams.

Chamber puts AIOps agents on call for your ML infrastructure. They diagnose failed training jobs, reclaim idle GPUs, and keep every node healthy — automatically when it's safe, with a human in the loop when it isn't — so researchers stay focused on building models, not fighting the cluster.

CUDA OOM @ step 1,847

BUILT BY VETERANS FROM

See the fleet the agents are babysitting.

One surface for the GPU estate: what's running, what's failing, where capacity is stranded, and what the agents are doing about it.

Ask in Slack. Get the ops done.

Chambie takes the tedious infra work off researchers — triaging failures, proposing typed fixes, packing idle GPUs — and only asks a human when risk is high.

The ops AI scientists shouldn’t do — watching runs, chasing failures, and keeping experiments moving without a human in the loop.

Diagnoses what broke, applies a typed fix, reruns from checkpoint, and stays on the job until the run is healthy again.

Sees when accelerators sit idle through CPU stretches, packs stranded capacity, and makes existing nodes earn their keep.

Every incident and every healthy run teaches the agents. Your cluster gets a teammate that compounds over time.

Works where you work — Slack · CLI · Python SDK · web console · webhooks

Built for GPU fleets — not a generic chat agent.

From high-level infra babysitting down to phase-level packing on the node, Chamber agents are wired into a live model of your cluster — workloads, failure modes, and blast radius. That's why they can act safely while researchers stay in the science.

Live workload graph

Every run is structured state — topology, checkpoints, configs, owners, GPU/CPU phases, cost — kept current in real time. Agents reason over the fleet, not over raw logs.

Pattern bank of failure modes

OOMs, NCCL timeouts, ECC errors, stragglers. Every incident Chamber resolves becomes a matched signature with a known-good fix — your cluster inherits them on day one.

Phase-aware packing

When a job is in a CPU-heavy stretch, GPUs sit idle. Chamber sees those phases and packs work so expensive accelerators stay busy on the nodes you already own.

Guardrailed remediation

Fixes are typed actions — requeue, reconfig, rerun from checkpoint — with blast-radius limits and rollback. Autonomous at 3am, safe enough for auditors.

AI scientists didn't sign up to do ops.

name: Hesper AI
brief:
Product: Hesper AI
One-liner: AI Claims Investigator for Insurance
Description: Hesper AI builds AI agents that investigate P&C insurance claims end to end. Hesper’s agents read the claim file, detect tampered documents, verify facts, check coverage, flag inconsistencies, and produce an audit-ready case file in minutes, so insurers can check every claim. We work with Claims and SIU orgs at Carriers, MGAs and TPAs,
Industry: Fintech / Insurance
Tags: Insurance, Fraud Detection, AI
target:
Every Claim. First Notice to Final Recovery.

Hesper is the AI claims resolution platform. AI agents run the entire lifecycle - intake, coverage, investigation, settlement, recovery - resolving clean claims straight through and giving suspicious ones an investigation-grade workup in hours, not weeks.

Insurance is a promise. The claim is the moment the promise is kept - or broken .

Today that moment takes twenty-four days, leaks five to ten percent of every dollar, and decides whether the policyholder ever renews. Claims teams didn't get slower - claims got heavier. More documents, more regulation, more fraud, more litigation, while every stage still waits on a human reading paper.

Hesper turns the claim itself into software. Every stage runs the moment the last one finishes. Every decision carries its evidence. People handle judgment, not paperwork.

Claims Crawl. Costs Climb.

Property cycle times sit at a record 23.9 days and claims satisfaction at a seven-year low. Claims are the largest cost line an insurer manages - and every stage still waits on a human reading documents.

We Run the Whole Claim.

AI agents execute every stage from first notice to final recovery. Your team keeps authority over every decision - the agents do the reading, gathering, drafting, and checking.

Speed for Policyholders. Control for Claims Teams.

Claims resolve in hours instead of weeks. Payments and denials carry their evidence. Volume scales without headcount - and your best people spend their time on judgment, not paperwork.

One platform. Eight stages. Zero handoffs.

From the first notice of loss to the last recovered dollar, Hesper's agents run each stage the moment the last one finishes - and hand your team the evidence, not the busywork.

FNOL & Intake

Triage & Assignment

Coverage

Investigation

Estimation & Valuation

Settlement

Payment & Closure

Recovery

$15B in recoverable dollars goes uncollected every year. Hesper screens every file for it.

Claims, before and after Hesper.

The only claims AI with an investigation engine inside.

Every automation vendor routes the hard claims to humans. Hesper works them. Built-in fraud detection plus a 15-phase investigation engine means every claim gets SIU-grade scrutiny - not just the flagged few.

AI claims automation that actually works.

Built to answer the four questions every claims leader asks - at pilot, at renewal, and every day on the desk.

Every page, read end to end.

name: ArchiLabs
brief:
Product: ArchiLabs
One-liner: AI Data Center Design
Description: ArchiLabs is building the data center project OS.
Industry: Real Estate and Construction / Construction
Tags: SaaS, Construction, B2B, Proptech, AI
target:
Design data centers at machine speed

ArchiLabs Studio automates the work between a data center brief and an operations-ready facility—layouts, power and cooling coordination, cable routing, specifications, RFIs, documentation, validation, and structured handoff.

One studio at the center of your data center workflow

ArchiLabs connects models, engineering analysis, project documents, and operational systems. Generate the design, route critical pathways, answer project questions, and preserve structured data through handoff.

Central intelligence

ArchiLabs Studio

The data center project OS

PDFs + spec sheets

Extract equipment data

RFIs + submittals

Draft grounded responses

DCIM systems

Sync asset-ready data

EPMS + BMS

Connect design to ops

Excel + reports

Schedules, BOMs, handoff

Cable + fiber

Route diverse pathways

CFD + thermal

Coordinate cooling inputs

Revit + AutoCAD

Models, sheets, details

Connect through files, APIs, and project-specific automation without replacing the tools your teams already trust.

Automation that goes far beyond BIM

Use AI where it accelerates the work, deterministic rules where precision matters, and structured project data everywhere—from early layouts through operations handoff.

Generate Data Hall Layouts

Turn capacity, density, phasing, and redundancy requirements into coordinated rack, equipment, and white-space options that stay editable as the brief changes.

Route Every Critical Path

Automate A/B power paths, cable tray, fiber, piping, and ductwork while preserving separation, service access, bend, clearance, and connection rules.

Read Specs and Project Documents

Pull equipment parameters, dimensions, performance data, and requirements out of PDFs and manufacturer spec sheets, then use that information in the model and schedules.

Respond to RFIs Faster

Draft answers using project specifications, model context, prior decisions, and equipment data—then keep every response traceable to the information that supports it.

Coordinate Power and Cooling

Track capacity and redundancy, validate clearances and failure domains, and prepare structured geometry and data for CFD, electrical analysis, and coordination workflows.

Hand Off Operations-Ready Data

Generate sheets, schedules, reports, asset registers, and structured handoff data for Revit, AutoCAD, Excel, DCIM, EPMS, BMS, and owner-specific systems.

Coordinate every critical system— not just the model

Data center decisions ripple across racks, electrical topology, cooling, cable and fiber, equipment schedules, RFIs, analysis models, construction documents, and operational systems. ArchiLabs Studio keeps those workflows connected so teams can iterate quickly without losing traceability or rebuilding the same information in every tool.

A rack move ripples manually across power, cooling, cable, schedules, and sheets

Change the layout once — connected workflows reroute, recheck, and update the deliverables

Equipment data is retyped from manufacturer PDFs into models and spreadsheets
